summary: Four commits on this branch refine cleanup-next-build-lock.js to fix false-positive stuck-process detection and orphaned next build processes blocking the quality gate (2026-05-03/04). Key logic verified present on main: isProcessAlive(), getPPID(), isNextBuildRunning(), STALE_AGE_MS, pgrep 'next build' specificity. Changes incorporated via PR #1471 (2026-05-04) and PR #1482 (2026-05-04). Main has since evolved 3 more times (PRs #1534, #1537, #1922). Branch is obsolete — no unique work lost. Safe to delete.
